verdict.rationale: Probes show no llms.txt and no markdown docs endpoint (both HTTP 404). However, Isaac Lab documents a shipped library of agent skills covering installation, environment creation, RL training and migration, and Isaac ROS documents a dedicated AI agent skill, which is agent-oriented guidance an agent can be pointed at. missing for 10: llms.txt, markdown or agent-readable versions of the main docs, coverage of agent-oriented docs beyond Isaac Lab and Isaac ROS skills, independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can use these skills.
